instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Design a pipelined module that implements a 2-bit counter with a synchronous reset and a synchronous load. 
The module should have two inputs (LOAD and RESET), a clock input (CLK), and a 2-bit output (Q). When RESET is high, the output Q should be set to 00. 
When LOAD is high, the output Q should be set to the value of the input data (DATA[1:0]). Otherwise, the output Q should be incremented on each rising edge of the clock.
Use pipeline structure to achieve this functionality.
